answers.admission: 🎓 ADMISSION REQUIREMENTS 📋 ELIGIBILITY: • Undergraduate: FSc/A-Levels + 60% marks • Entry Test score required • Graduate: Bachelor's degree + 2.5 GPA 📄 REQUIRED DOCUMENTS: • Application form • Transcripts • Test scores (Entry Test, GRE, GMAT) • Statement of Purpose (1-2 pages) • 2 recommendation letters • Valid CNIC/Passport 📅 DEADLINES & FEES: • Fall: June 30 • Spring: November 30 • Fee: PKR 2,500 (non-refundable) • Decision: Within 4 weeks Contact: 051-5214800 Ext. 101
answers.handbook_scholarships: 🏆 SCHOLARSHIPS AVAILABLE ⭐ MERIT-BASED: • Full Tuition Waiver: GPA 3.8+ or Entry Test 85+ • 50% Scholarship: GPA 3.5-3.79 or Entry Test 75-84 • 25% Scholarship: GPA 3.2-3.49 or Entry Test 65-74 💵 NEED-BASED: • Up to 100% tuition coverage • Based on FAFSA or financial form 📝 HOW TO APPLY: 1. Complete main application 2. Fill scholarship form 3. Submit documents (transcripts, financial info) 4. Write 250-word essay 5. Attend interview 📅 DEADLINES: • Fall: June 30 • Spring: November 30 ✅ RENEWAL: • Maintain 3.2+ GPA • Full-time enrollment (12+ credits) • Annual FAFSA renewal Contact: 051-5214800 Ext. 123
answers.handbook_attendance: 📋 ATTENDANCE POLICY ✅ REQUIREMENT: • 75% mandatory attendance • Calculated as: Classes Attended / Total Classes × 100 ⚠️ CONSEQUENCES: • 60-74%: Academic warning + course repeat • Below 60%: Automatic F grade 🏥 MEDICAL ABSENCES: • Doctor's certificate within 3 days • Max 5 medical leaves/semester 📄 EXCUSED ABSENCES: • Family emergency or religious observance • Written request + supporting docs 📧 REPORT ABSENCES: • Within 48 hours to instructor • Email notification recommended 💡 OPTIONS: • Make-up classes available • Failed courses can be retaken • Special exceptions: Contact Student Affairs (3 weeks notice)
answers.handbook_grading: 📊 GRADING SYSTEM 📈 LETTER GRADES: • A = 90-100% (4.0) | A- = 87-89% (3.7) • B+ = 83-86% (3.3) | B = 80-82% (3.0) • B- = 77-79% (2.7) | C+ = 73-76% (2.3) • C = 70-72% (2.0) | C- = 67-69% (1.7) • D+ = 63-66% (1.3) | D = 60-62% (1.0) • F = Below 60% (0.0) 📈 GPA STANDARDS: • Good Standing: 2.0+ • Dean's List: 3.5+ • Academic Probation: Below 2.0 🔄 INCOMPLETE GRADE (I): • Only if 75% coursework passed • Complete within 30 days • Reverts to F if not completed ✏️ GRADE APPEALS (within 10 days): 1. Meet instructor 2. Written appeal to Chair 3. Final appeal to Dean 🔁 RETAKES: • Allowed for any grade • Highest grade replaces previous
answers.handbook_conduct: ⚖️ CODE OF CONDUCT 🚫 PROHIBITED ACADEMIC CONDUCT: • Plagiarism: Using others' work without credit • Cheating: Unauthorized collaboration, copying • Fabrication: Inventing data or citations • Unauthorized group work: Submitting as individual ⚠️ NON-ACADEMIC MISCONDUCT: • Harassment, discrimination, violence • Bullying, threats, theft • Property damage, substance abuse • IT policy violations ⚙️ DISCIPLINARY PROCESS: 1. Report: Violation reported to Student Affairs/Chair 2. Investigation: 7-10 days 3. Hearing: Student can defend with advisor 4. Decision: Committee decides 5. Appeal: 5 days to appeal to Dean 🔨 PENALTIES: • Warning (minor offense) • Probation (continuing misconduct) • F grade (academic dishonesty) • Suspension (1-2 semesters) • Expulsion (severe/repeated violations)
answers.handbook_withdrawal: 📋 WITHDRAWAL & LEAVE OF ABSENCE 🔄 COURSE WITHDRAWAL: • Drop individual courses • Doesn't affect GPA • Transcript shows 'WD' 💰 REFUND TIMELINE: • Day 1-25 (before census): 80% • Day 26-50 (before midterm): 50% • After midterm: 0% 📋 HOW TO WITHDRAW: 1. Get form from Registrar 2. Get signatures: Financial + Academic advisor 3. Clear outstanding balances 4. Submit to Registrar 5. Processing: 5-7 business days ✈️ LEAVE OF ABSENCE (LOA): • Up to 2 consecutive semesters • Keeps enrollment status & scholarships ✅ VALID REASONS: • Medical (physician letter) • Family emergency (death/illness) • Personal hardship (Dean approval) • Military service 📧 PROCESS: • Submit LOA + docs to Student Affairs • Approval: Within 10 days • Must return or face dismissal

answers.about_university: 🎓 SUKKUR IBA UNIVERSITY — AT A GLANCE Sukkur IBA University is among the top five business institutes in Pakistan (HEC ranking). ✨ KEY HIGHLIGHTS • Strict merit-based admission system • Quality education focused on global competitiveness • Strong foundation semester for student success 🎯 WHAT WE AIM FOR • High-quality, affordable education • Collaboration with top national and international institutions • Strong foundation semester to improve learning standards • Graduates equipped with knowledge, practical skills, research ability and critical thinking 📋 ADMISSION POLICY Our admission policy guides students through available programs, eligibility requirements, and the registration and enrollment process. Contact the Registrar's Office for more details. Ext. 101 | registrar@sukkuriba.edu.pk
answers.about_BBA: 🎓 DEPARTMENT OF BUSINESS ADMINISTRATION 📋 MISSION STATEMENT The Department of Business Administration prepares students with a global outlook and research-driven learning. It focuses on developing leadership, entrepreneurial thinking, ethical awareness and a commitment to continuous improvement so graduates can contribute meaningfully to society. 🎯 BBA PROGRAM (4 YEARS) 🏆 OVERALL EDUCATIONAL GOALS The BBA program aims to build the knowledge and skills students need to: • Perform effectively in managerial roles in local and multinational organizations • Start and grow successful entrepreneurial ventures • Pursue higher studies such as MBA, MS or PhD at reputable national or international universities 📖 WANT MORE INFO? For eligibility criteria, generic learning goals, and courses offered, visit: BBA_introduction
answers.about_CS: 💻 DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE 📋 MISSION STATEMENT The mission of Computer Science Department is to provide quality education in both theory and applications of computer science, information technology and software engineering to serve the community. We aim to integrate with other departments for achieving knowledge as a whole. We strive to equip our graduates with awareness of ethical norms and technological skills to promote their entrepreneurial behavior and leadership expertise.
